{{About|the Hasbro list|List of Beyblade X products (Takara Tomy)|the Takara Tomy list}} This is a list of releases in the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline in western countries. The toyline was first released in western countries in summer 2024 and the series is handled by [[Hasbro]]. The toyline was first revealed on March 22nd, 2024 via press release, with on-hand access on March 23rd, 2024.
